name: Cobbleverse x Create Reforged + Industries Beta
description: Makes Create Reforged and Create Aeronautics Reforged work with the COBBLEVERSE modpack: fixes the Porting Lib conflict that froze loading, the Pokemon spawn kick, and the Aeronautics startup crash on older Fabric Loaders. Adds REI support for most Create machine recipes (Create Reforged only ships a JEI plugin). Bundles Fabric ports of Create Threaded Trains, Create Cobblestone, Create: Cobblemon Balls Overhaul, Create Cobblemon Potion and an Accessories slot for the Aviator's Goggles. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Create, Create Reforged, Cobblemon or COBBLEVERSE.
contributors: Ported mods by: MrJulsen (Create Threaded Trains, GPL-3.0), MrStickyPiston (Create Cobblestone, CC0-1.0), xKcinnay (Create: Cobblemon Balls Overhaul, MIT), Junto (Create Cobblemon Potion, MIT); goggles idea from titammods (Create Aeronautics Curios Compat)
